title: Order Renewal and Continued-Need Documentation, Urological Supply Program
content:
A renewed order or newer continued-need documentation for a Urological Supply Program enrollment is recorded only from the practitioner's signed documents, never from the patient's statement. Recording it clears an order-expired or continued-need-lapsed hold. An indwelling catheter is changed every change interval in days of the program, and the latex content of the program (whether its catheter is latex-free) is confirmed against any allergy on the order before renewal.

## Source of the record

| Offered as the basis | Recorded as a renewed order or continued-need documentation |
|---|---|
| practitioner's signed order or signed continued-need documentation | yes |
| patient's statement that the doctor renewed it | no |

## What recording does

- It records the renewed order date, or the newer continued-need documentation date.
- It clears a hold whose reason is order expired or continued need lapsed.

## Indwelling change interval and latex content

- The change interval is the number of days between routine changes of an indwelling catheter; it applies to the Indwelling Foley Catheter Program (A4338) and the All-Silicone Indwelling Catheter Program (A4344).
- Before renewal, the program's latex content is confirmed against any allergy on the order. *Hypothetical case:* an order on the Indwelling Foley Catheter Program (A4338), whose catheter is not latex-free, lists a latex allergy; that program's latex content is checked against the allergy before the renewal.
